calls.prompt:
Create ONE 2D fighting-game CHARACTER REFERENCE SHEET of Mr. Gray (the Faceless), an ORIGINAL character for an original
indie fighting game. It must NOT resemble any existing anime, manga, game or film character.

The FIRST attached image is the approved HOUSE STYLE (another character of this game): copy its rendering exactly - the same
premium high-detail anime fighting-game sprite style, line work, cel shading, metal highlights, proportions, scale and the
same kind of sheet layout - but draw Mr. Gray, NOT the character shown there. The SECOND attached image is Mr. Gray's portrait:
match the face, hair, colours and costume from it.

THE CHARACTER:
A tall, slim, gaunt gentleman of about fifty: narrow-shouldered, very upright, long-legged, with a composed and unhurried bearing. Face: pale, angular and smooth, half-shadowed under the peak of his cap, calm narrow grey eyes and a faint polite half-smile; the cheeks and jaw dissolve at their edges into drifting grey fog. Headwear: a black PEAKED CAP with a dark charcoal crown, a black band and a tarnished BRASS cog-and-star badge. Costume: a long dark charcoal-grey GREATCOAT to mid-calf with a high turned-up collar and a short cape over the shoulders, a double row of tarnished brass buttons, a black leather belt with a brass buckle, a thin brass watch chain across the waistcoat, dark charcoal trousers, polished black boots and black leather gloves. WEAPON: a long black lacquered BATON-CUDGEL about as long as his forearm and upper arm together, with a heavy ridged black-steel head and a brass butt cap; the right hand grips it low on a black leather wrap, and the left hand joins only for the heavy strikes. Effects are pale silver-grey fog swirls with cool white glints.

ART STYLE: Premium, high-detail anime 2D fighting-game sprite art: the look of a carefully hand-pixelled character sprite rendered at high resolution - crisp deliberate dark outlines (not thick black cartoon lines), cel shading with three to four tones per material, bright specular highlights on metal, a cool rim light, an expressive face with a clear eye, anatomically correct hands with readable fingers, convincing anime anatomy, fluid hair and cloth that follow the motion. Exactly the rendering, palette and level of detail of the attached reference sheet. Not vector art, not blurry, not chibi, no photorealism.

SHEET CONTENT (transparent background, image 1536x1024, no text, no labels, no grid lines, every figure separate):
- top row: full-body neutral stance facing right; a composed combat stance with the baton ready; a measured walking pose; a stride with the coat swinging; a leaping jump with the coat billowing; a close-up of the cap and the baton head
- middle rows: six attack poses: two heavy overhead baton blows, a wide sideways sweep, a stepping ground slam with fog, an airborne baton blow, a Grim Fog pose with his outline dissolving into fog; grey fog and silver glints in each
- bottom row: guard with the baton across the body, hit reaction, knocked down, victory pose with the baton upright like a cane, the Grim Fog cloud at full spread
Every figure faces RIGHT (three-quarter side view like the house style), the same scale (standing height about 240 px), feet on
the same ground line within each row.
